lead: A count or a dot hung on the corner of another element (an icon, an avatar, a button), or shown on its own. For a text label, a status or a keyword, see [Tag](/tag).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: `count` is the number (or text) in the indicator; the element inside is what it hangs on.

max.title: Maximum and zero
max.description: A number above `max` (default 99) shows as `99+`; 0 is not drawn unless `showZero`.

dot.title: Dot
dot.description: `dot` is a plain dot without a number, for "something new here".

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: The corner it hangs on; `top-end` by default.

standalone.title: On its own
standalone.description: Without a child the indicator is drawn inline, for a count in a list row or a menu item.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `badge.css`; the colours are the `--ui-c-*` solid and foreground tokens.
styling.slot: The wrapper (`badge`) around the child, and the indicator (`badge-indicator`) with the number
styling.root: On the wrapper; `data-wrapped` is set when it has a child, and `data-placement` only then
styling.dot: On the indicator when it is a dot
